12                 ACTING PRESIDENT PERSAUD:   Senator 

13    Rhoads to explain his vote.

14                 SENATOR RHOADS:   Thank you, 

15    Madam President.  

16                 While I certainly have no problem 

17    with regulating horseshoe crabs, and we've had 

18    extensive debates on the floor with regard to 

19    this, I do believe that there should have been 

20    some exception carved out for biomedical 

21    research.  

22                 I think you're inhibiting New York 

23    State being an innovator with respect to 

24    biomedical research by restricting horseshoe 

25    crabs from being used for that purpose.  


                                                                138

 1                 I certainly agree with the 

 2    restrictions for other purposes, but for that 

 3    reason I have to cast my vote in opposition.
